doc: Gil's model file (art/wardens/gil/gil.glb). The .glb carries no clips yet (his rig pass is ANIM_COVERAGE gap 1), so "clips_from" lends him Meeko's (art/wardens/pip/pip.glb, the Hunter of his build: legs and arms within 5% of his), retargeted by bone name (WardenClips._borrow; the same contract armature and rest rotations, no Blender): idle, walk, run and strafe rings, the jump and fall, the crouch and its dips, the landing and the hit staggers. Everything else stays on the rig's HunterAnim poses: his kit moves (no kmoves), stun, glide, knock-down, death, downed, reviving, ledges and the base recall ("procedural"); the emote wheel and summon call play the shared gestures. The swordfish is skinned to hand.R in the .glb: the procedural swordfish (HeroArmsGil) hides and the Gun node is only the invisible aim and FX reference, kept on the blade empties (anchor_blade_root on hand.R, weapon_muzzle at the bill tip) so thrusts, potions and the spout leave the weapon you see.
